title: SubSaipen OUTBOX Schema
description: Descriptive reference only, same footing as board.schema.json/log.schema.json -- not read by any agent today. extensions/subs/PROTOCOL.md § 2 is the living spec for this shape.

id.description: e.g. WIKI-001 -- prefix per PROTOCOL.md § 3, never a T-### (that ID is assigned only once folded onto the main BOARD.md)

producer.description: Required for a complete package consumed by Core saipen collect <producer>

source_head.description: Full source Git HEAD or no-git; required for a complete package

source_tree_fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint over the producer's relevant source surface including uncommitted tracked/untracked changes, excluding its own kitchen/OUTBOX noise (PROTOCOL.md freshness section, T-543)

role_revision.description: The effective charter revision the producer spawned/adopted against (PROTOCOL.md § 3.1 metadata block, T-541/T-542)

coverage.description: Exact source surfaces and locale/page scope completed; required for a complete package

payload.description: Exact files or artifacts to integrate; required for a complete package

verified.description: Producer-side checks and results; required for a complete package

instructions.description: Ordered integration instructions; required for a complete package
